items.text:
Interesting game, the derelict salvaging gameplay is nice and the ship building too. however lots of content are still in development. 

For example, on one of my salvaging missions i encountered a person who was blacking out due to oxygen loss, he was in atmo suit. Tried to help him with medicine, but this mechanic is not yet implemented so i was just hitting him with syringe in the attempt to help him. He died from bleeding out, instead of suffocation.

Another problem is bugs, like the inability to finish the salvage request from the NPC, no interaction with objects until save is reloaded, or the strange bug that makes all npc in the port go to one specific terminal and do something lika a "group handshaking" while dropping all their stuff on the floor.

Still a nice game, hope they will fix bugs and add content in the future.
items.text_zh:
有趣的游戏，废弃飞船打捞玩法很不错，飞船建造也是。不过很多内容仍在开发中。

例如，在我的一次打捞任务中，我遇到一个人因为缺氧而昏厥，他穿着大气服。我试图用药物帮助他，但这个机制尚未实装，所以我只能拿注射器戳他，试图帮他。他最终死于失血，而不是窒息。

另一个问题是bug，比如无法完成NPC的打捞请求，在重新加载存档之前无法与物体互动，或者那个奇怪的bug，让港口里所有NPC都跑到某个特定的终端，做某种类似“集体握手”的事情，同时把他们所有的东西都丢在地上。

仍然是个不错的游戏，希望他们将来能修复bug并添加内容。

items.text:
One of the few games that compensate for lack of fancy graphics or 3D world with sheer gameplay. You salvage, you mine, you build, you earn and survive, all aboard veritable coffins that are proudly called 'spacecrafts'. Sadly this is marred by a legion of game-breaking issues.

Pros:
- Developers nailed the art style and made a game that matches it
- Variety of mechanics, lots of different things to do
- Space with 'physics' done in a fun way, you use Newtonian physics to travel instead of fighting it
- Sensor gameplay and space combat

Pain Points:
- AI is broken. NPCs sleeping on the floor, drinking water till they are nauseous, stealing your food, denying you docking to one of your ship are just toppings. NPCs walking into fires for food, going into N2-only atmosphere without a helmet, ramming planets, picking fights with police and exterminating police population... NPCs don't live very long, but that's still not the worst of it. What takes the cake: ramming player, venting player's atmosphere, flinging player into the planet, accelerating player to 2km/s in seconds (when you have 1km/s delta-v)... that's the game's norm for the NPCs.
- Game has depth but player has little to affect that depth. As an example oxygen and atmosphere overall are detailed yet there is no airlock (only a mislabeled docking port) so you choice is to cheat by fusing yourself with the docking port or to let atmosphere out. No proper atmosphere distribution either (the bigger the ship the more apparent it becomes). Medical conditions are detailed, yet there is very little feedback for yourself and no option at all to treat NPCs. Fuel and power can't be transferred between ships, sans dragging massive tanks around. Sensors aren't configurable.
- BUGS. Dialogues get stack; 'Resume action' button sometimes doesn't work (lacks error feedback?); Autopause doesn't work half the time; NPCs can't wake up; Jump cables take longer to install than proper cables.

Cons:
- Inventory. The bigger your ship the more frustating it becomes (like having multiple bins full of bags, cargo pants in those bags, just to store small items like spare parts and food).
- You have to baby-sit a lot of actions (malfucntioning autopause doesn't help).
- Orders have no proper queue or priorities.
- Lack of variety in a lot of aspects, especially for ships (Ex: a single RCS, single power source). Quite a few derelicts are practically new because there is no 'obsolete' parts or technologies. Damage could have had more depth too. 
- Progression needs refining
- Overall incomplete.

I want to love this game, but at this point the game is not worth it. The game is only half done.
items.text_zh:
这是少数几款用纯粹的游戏玩法弥补了缺乏华丽画面或3D世界的游戏之一。你打捞、你采矿、你建造、你赚钱并生存，这一切都在名副其实的棺材上，它们被自豪地称为“宇宙飞船”。遗憾的是，这被一大堆破坏游戏的问题所玷污。

优点：
- 开发者敲定了美术风格，并做出了一款与之匹配的游戏
- 机制多样，有很多不同的事情可做
- 太空“物理”以有趣的方式呈现，你利用牛顿物理学来移动，而不是与之对抗
- 传感器玩法和太空战斗

痛点：
- AI坏了。NPC睡在地板上、喝水喝到恶心、偷你的食物、拒绝让你停靠到你自己的一艘船上，这些还只是小菜。NPC为了食物走进火里、不戴头盔进入只有氮气的大气、撞行星、挑衅警察并灭绝警察人口……NPC活不了多久，但这还不是最糟的。最离谱的是：撞玩家、排放玩家的大气、把玩家甩进行星、在几秒内把玩家加速到2公里/秒（当你只有1公里/秒的Δv时）……这就是游戏中NPC的常态。
- 游戏有深度，但玩家几乎无法影响这种深度。例如，氧气和整体大气做得很细致，却没有气闸（只有一个标错的对接端口），所以你的选择要么是把自己和对接端口融合在一起作弊，要么就是把大气放出去。也没有合适的大气分配（船越大就越明显）。医疗状况做得很细致，但你几乎得不到关于自身的反馈，也完全没有治疗NPC的选项。燃料和电力无法在飞船之间转移，除非拖着巨大的储罐到处跑。传感器不可配置。
- BUG。对话会堆叠；“恢复动作”按钮有时不起作用（缺少错误反馈？）；自动暂停一半时间都不工作；NPC无法醒来；跨接电缆安装起来比正规电缆还久。

缺点：
- 物品栏。你的船越大就越令人沮丧（就像有多个装满袋子的箱子，袋子里还有工装裤，只是为了存放备件和食物之类的小物品）。
- 很多操作你都得亲自盯着（自动暂停失灵更是雪上加霜）。
- 命令没有合适的队列或优先级。
- 很多方面缺乏多样性，尤其是飞船（例如：只有一个RCS、一个电源）。相当多的废弃船实际上几乎是新的，因为没有“过时”的部件或技术。损伤本也可以更有深度。
- 进度需要改进
- 总体不完整。

我想爱上这款游戏，但就目前而言，这游戏不值得。这游戏只完成了一半。
